sampling_rule: For each integer seed 0..99, construct a fresh random.Random(seed), draw 192 uniform uint32 selection quantiles using the existing MelosGenome.random, then Trial(genome, seed, baseline, reference=False). No GA, elite reuse, breeding, fitness selection, replacement, or result-dependent seed choice.
classification_rule:
First applied action_completed for Melos move to court, using details.arrived_at (physical arrival). <=3960=in_time; >3960=late. Successful return work report and PromiseRegistry fulfillment are separate evidence.
Melos work_unit_completed for task wedding plus applied action_completed for wedding work. Attendance means completion of the existing 120-minute wedding participation task, not request/consent or village presence.
observation_stop: Keep the existing Trial.run behavior: stop at its terminal outcome, attempted action outside horizon, or existing decision limit; never continue or force a different action. Nonreturn means no court arrival observed by this episode stop, not never returning in future life.
source: Repository UI compatibility fixture derived from the historical pre-nine-gene baseline. Private evidence links and detailed narratives are omitted.
